target: Recorded NYC rides starting on the next local calendar day
information_cutoff: After the previous calendar day has finished and its daily total is available
primary_metric: MAE in rides/day; lower is better
baseline: Same count as seven days earlier
validation_protocol: Fit through June once; issue rolling one-day forecasts for July-September using each day's actually observed prior history, without refitting during that validation period
selection: Tune on chronological training folds; compare selected configurations on the common July-September development validation period; refit the chosen local candidate on January-September development data
test_policy: No test model predictions or metrics until AWS candidates and all final choices are frozen; evaluate the final test once
limitations: Earlier EDA and hypothesis work examined January-September, so this is development validation, not independent confirmation. Only one year is available. No future weather, same-day rides or test target is a feature. Counts describe recorded trips, not unmet demand.
